components.textContent:
If your Army Faction is **HERETIC ASTARTES**, each time a unit with this ability is selected to shoot or fight, it can make a Dark Pact. If it does, it must first take a Leadership test before any effects of that Dark Pact are resolved; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, select one of the following abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain until the end of the phase:

■ **[LETHAL HITS]**
■ **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**
Beseeching the Chaos Gods with fanatical fervour, the profane champions of the Heretic Astartes pray for diabolic boons, promising the vilest of offerings in return for their power.

components.textContent:
If your Army Faction is **HERETIC ASTARTES**, you can include any of the following units in your army, and when you do so their Faction keywords are replaced with **HERETIC ASTARTES**:

■ **KHORNE BERZERKERS** (see World Eaters)
■ **RUBRIC MARINES** (see Thousand Sons)
■ **PLAGUE MARINES** (see Death Guard)
■ **NOISE MARINES** (see Emperor’s Children)

The combined points value of such units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as follows:

■ **Incursion**: Up to 250 pts
■ **Strike Force**: Up to 500 pts
■ **Onslaught**: Up to 750 pts
Some traitors have given themselves entirely to the service of the Dark Gods, and they are so lost to damnation that they barely resemble the warriors they once were.

enhancements.rules: <k>Heretic Astartes Daemon</k> model only (excluding <k>Khorne</k> models). This model’s melee attacks have <k>[Lance]</k>.

enhancements.name: Touched by the Warp
enhancements.rules:
Heretic Astartes model only (excluding Khorne models).
  • This model has Psyker.
  • This model’s weapons have [Psychic].

stratagems.name: Fleshy Curse
stratagems.whenRules: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One friendly <k>Heretic Astartes Psyker</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules:
Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. Roll one D6:
  • On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
  • On a 2‑4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
  • On a 5‑6, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds.
These mortal wounds are inflicted by a psychic attack.

stratagems.name: Infernal Vigour
stratagems.whenRules: Your Command phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One friendly <k>Heretic Astartes Psyker/Daemon</k> unit (excluding <k>Khorne</k> units).
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit heals D3+1 wounds.

stratagems.name: Wreathed in Warpflame
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Heretic Astartes Psyker unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>Heretic Astartes Psyker</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit’s ranged attacks have <k>[Ignores Cover]</k>.

The sorcerous powers wielded by a cabal inevitably draw the attention of the Dark Gods, flooding the battlefield with immaterial energies that empower their dark magicks and their daemonically gifted comrades alike.

enhancements.name: Amulet of Tainted Vigour
enhancements.rules: **DARK APOSTLE** model only. In your Command phase, you can return up to D3 destroyed **DAMNED** models (excluding **CHARACTER** models) to the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Cultist’s Brand
enhancements.rules: **DARK APOSTLE** or **DAMNED** model only. If every other model in the bearer’s unit (excluding Dark Disciples) is **DAMNED**, you can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Incendiary Goad
enhancements.rules: **DARK APOSTLE** or **DAMNED** model only. While the bearer’s unit is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by **DAMNED** models in that unit, and while that unit is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those weapons as well.

enhancements.name: Warped Foresight
enhancements.rules: **DARK APOSTLE** or **DAMNED** model only. While the bearer is leading a unit with the Scouts 6" ability, every model in the bearer’s unit has the Scouts 6" ability.

stratagems.name: Chosen for Glory
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **DAMNED** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.name: Selfless Demise
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **DAMNED** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound after all of its attacks have been resolved.

stratagems.name: Infernal Sacrifice
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **DAMNED** unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds (in addition to any suffered for failing the resulting Leadership test), and until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, until the end of the phase, improve the Strength characteristic of those weapons by 1 as well.

stratagems.name: Crazed Focus
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **DAMNED** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1 as well.

stratagems.name: Reckless Haste
stratagems.whenRules: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **DAMNED** unit from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Mortal Thralls
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly **DAMNED** unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, while your **DAMNED** unit is on the battlefield, each time your opponent would make a Wound roll for an attack that targets your **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit, if your **DAMNED** unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no roll is made; instead, your **DAMNED** unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack.

components.textContent: Each time a **DAMNED** unit from your army with the Dark Pacts ability is selected  to make a Normal or Advance move or declare a charge (excluding units that arrived from Reserves this turn), it can make a Desperate Pact (see below). If it does, until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and add 2 to Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Helm of All-Seeing
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** model (excluding **DAMNED** models) only. Enemy units that are set up on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of the bearer.

enhancements.name: Living Carapace
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS LORD** model only. Add 1 to the bearer’s Wounds characteristic and the bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Prime Test Subject
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** model (excluding **DAMNED** models) only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, you can re‑roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Surgical Precision
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model (excluding **DAMNED** models) only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the **[PRECISION]** ability.

stratagems.name: Monstrous Visages
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Masters Are Watching
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, subtracting 1 from the result if it is a **DAMNED** unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Specimens For The Spider
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets a **CHARACTER** unit, you can re‑roll the Wound roll. After your unit has fought, if one or more enemy **CHARACTER** models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one enemy unit within 6" of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle‑shock test. If the enemy **WARLORD** was destroyed as a result of those attacks, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle‑shock test instead.

stratagems.name: Delayed Mutations
stratagems.whenRules: Your Command phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit (excluding **DAMNED** units) from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then select one augmentation (see Experimental Augmentations). Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit have the selected augmentation in addition to any other augmentations they have.

stratagems.name: Diabolic Regeneration
stratagems.whenRules: Your Command phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit (excluding **DAMNED** units) from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: One destroyed model (excluding **CHARACTER** models) is returned to your unit. If your unit is a **BATTLELINE** unit, D3 destroyed models (excluding **CHARACTER** models) are returned to your unit instead.

stratagems.name: Autostimulants
stratagems.whenRules: Start of your Charge phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

components.textContent: Bile’s creations, the Terata, possess a variety of mutations, all of which increase their transhuman lethality – for now.

enhancements.name: Crown of Worms
enhancements.rules: **WARPSMITH** model only. Add 3” to the range of the bearer’s Warpsmith, Master of Mechanisms and Enrage Machine Spirits abilities

enhancements.name: Cybinfernal Font
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model only (excluding **DAMNED** models). Models in the bearer’s unit have the **SOUL FORGE** keyword.

enhancements.name: Mark of the Soul Forges
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model only (excluding **DAMNED** models). Each time the bearer makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Wyredjinn
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model only (excluding **DAMNED** models). At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if the bearer is within range of an objective marker you control: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

stratagems.name: Touch of the Arkifane
stratagems.whenRules: Any phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army (excluding **DAMNED** units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, if your unit is selected to make a Dark Pact, you can select both abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain.

stratagems.name: Balefire Boon
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **SOUL FORGE** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Soul-Tally Offerings
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **SOUL FORGE** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a **CHARACTER**, **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Biomechanoid Regeneration
stratagems.whenRules: Your Command phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army (excluding **DAMNED** units).
stratagems.effectRules: One model in your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If your unit has the **SOUL FORGE** keyword, one model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.

stratagems.name: Forge-Fire Surge
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase, just after a **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.targetRules: That **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the **SOUL FORGE** keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.

stratagems.name: Unholy Fortitude
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **SOUL FORGE** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.

components.textContent:
**HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE** units from your army gain the **DAEMON** keyword.

**HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE**, **LORD DISCORDANT** and **VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE** units from your army gain the **SOUL FORGE** keyword.

**SOUL FORGE** units from your army have a 5+ invulnerable save.

The cybersorcerous power of Vashtorr’s boons is much in evidence amongst his worshippers. Nowhere is this more true than in the war engines that his cults take into battle, and which exhibit a nightmarish variety of biomechanoid mutations and daemon‑spawned powers. Whether wreathed in balefire, shimmeringly insubstantial or constantly regrowing battle‑damaged hull plating, these accursed war machines are incredibly hard to destroy.

enhancements.name: Cursed Fang
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** model only. Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1, and the bearer’s melee weapons have the **[PRECISION]** ability.

enhancements.name: Falsehood
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS LORD** model only (excluding **TERMINATOR** and **JUMP PACK** models). In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can set the bearer up in Reserves instead of setting it up on the battlefield. If you do, in one of your Movement phases, you can select one model in a friendly **LEGIONARIES** or **CHOSEN** unit that has two or more models remaining and is on the battlefield (excluding Attached units). The selected model is destroyed (ignoring any rules that are triggered when a model is destroyed) and the bearer is set up as close as possible to where that model was destroyed and only within Engagement Range of any enemy units if the destroyed model was within Engagement Range of those units. The bearer now attaches to that unit as its Leader.

enhancements.name: Shroud of Obfuscation
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** model only. The bearer has the Stealth and Lone Operative abilities.

enhancements.name: Soul Link
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** model only. At the start of your Command phase, you can select one other **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY CHARACTER** model from your army (excluding **EPIC HEROES**). Until the start of your next Command phase, the bearer gains the **PSYKER** keyword, and replace the bearer’s datasheet abilities with the datasheet abilities of the **CHARACTER** you selected.

stratagems.name: Detonator
stratagems.whenRules: Any phase, just after an enemy model with the Deadly Demise ability (excluding **TITANIC** models) is destroyed.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER** unit from your army that was within 18" of that enemy model when it was destroyed.
stratagems.effectRules: Your opponent does not roll to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by their model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted (if that ability inflicts a random number of mortal wounds, your opponent rolls to determine that number as normal).

stratagems.name: From All Sides
stratagems.whenRules: Start of your Charge phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Charge rolls made for your unit for each other **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army that made a Charge move this phase (to a maximum of +3).

stratagems.name: Pick Them Off
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.name: Coils of Deception
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase, just after a **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.targetRules: That **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Relentless Pursuit
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** or **HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED** unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Scrambled Coordinates
stratagems.whenRules: Start of the Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of your unit.

components.textContent: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select a number of **LEGIONARIES** and **CULTIST MOB** units from your army: until the end of the battle, those units, and any **CHARACTER** units attached to them (excluding **EPIC HEROES**), have the Infiltrators ability. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below.

components.altText: A table showing the number of units that gain the Infiltrators ability, depending on the battle size. In Incursion games, up to 2 Legionaries units and up to 2 Cultist Mob units. In Strike Force games, up to 3 Legionaries units and up to 3 Cultist Mob units. In Onslaught games, up to 4 Legionaries units and up to 4 Cultist Mob units.

components.textContent: There are those warbands that number amongst their ranks liars, schemers and infiltrators of far more prodigious skill than most heretics. Employing labyrinthine ploys, they unnerve their enemies and force them to chase ghosts and shadows. They embed themselves within combat zones long before showing their hand, seeding Chaos cults, identifying key targets and feeding misinformation to their foes.

enhancements.name: Eye of Oblivion
enhancements.rules: Warpsmith model only. When this unit is selected to shoot, select one enemy unit within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range until this unit has shot.

enhancements.name: Pact of Destruction
enhancements.rules:
Warpsmith model only.
  • When this unit uses its Dark Pacts ability, this unit can re‑roll Leadership rolls.
  • In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, if this unit used its Dark Pacts ability and if those attacks destroyed an enemy model, this unit heals 3 wounds.

stratagems.name: Ruination’s Bounty
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Havocs/Obliterators unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>Havocs/Obliterators</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules:

stratagems.targetRules: That <k>Havocs</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Undying Hatred
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly <k>Havocs/Obliterators</k> unit.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>Havocs/Obliterators</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

components.textContent: Friendly <k>Havocs/Obliterators</k> units’ ranged attacks have <k>[Heavy]</k>.
It is not enough for these heretical reavers merely to defeat their foes. Instead, they must pound all before them to smouldering oblivion with overwhelming salvoes of fire.

enhancements.name: Eater of Dread
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result for each Battle-shocked enemy unit that is on the battlefield: on a 5+, you gain 1CP

enhancements.name: Night’s Shroud
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS LORD** model only (excluding **TERMINATOR** models). Models in the bearer’s unit have the Stealth ability.

enhancements.name: Warp-Fuelled Thrusters
enhancements.rules: **JUMP PACK CHAOS LORD** model only. At the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove the bearer’s unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Willbreaker
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model only. In the Fight phase, after the bearer has made its attacks, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Depthless Cruelty
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Bloody Example
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, just after a **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army destroys a **CHARACTER** unit.
stratagems.targetRules: That **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Each enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Pitiless Hunters
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Relentless Terror
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase, just after a **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.targetRules: That **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Screaming Descent
stratagems.whenRules: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, from the second battle round onwards.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES JUMP PACK** unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effectRules: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, but until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge. Then select one enemy **INFANTRY** or **MOUNTED** unit within 9" of and visible to your unit: that unit must take a Battle‐shock test.

stratagems.name: Merciless Pursuit
stratagems.whenRules: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effectRules: Select one enemy unit that Fell Back this turn and is within 6" of your unit. Your unit can declare a charge as if it were your Charge phase. When doing so, you can only select that enemy unit as the target of that charge (and only if it is an eligible target). Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

components.textContent: When mustering your army, when you select a **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit to include in your army, if that unit is not an **EPIC HERO** and does not already have one of the following keywords, you must select one for that unit and note it on your Army Roster: **KHORNE**, **TZEENTCH**, **NURGLE**, **SLAANESH**, **CHAOS UNDIVIDED**. Each time a unit with one of these keywords gains a weapon ability as the result of a Dark Pact and does not fail the resulting Leadership test, until the end of the phase, that unit gains the associated ability below.
Units That Gained [LETHAL HITS]

■ **KHORNE**: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
■ **TZEENTCH**: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
■ **CHAOS UNDIVIDED**: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
Units That Gained [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

■ **NURGLE**: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
■ **SLAANESH**: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
■ **CHAOS UNDIVIDED**: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Renegade Claim
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effectRules: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Corrupted Munitions
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit in your army that has just been selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, improve the Armour Penetration of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Reavers’ Reaction
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit (excluding **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**) from your army that was hit by one or more of those attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

components.textContent:
**HERETIC ASTARTES** models from your army lose the Dark Pacts ability.

Ranged weapons equipped by **HERETIC ASTARTES** models from your army have the **[ASSAULT]** ability.

When mustering your army, you cannot use the Cults of the Dark Gods rule.
Vendetta
Bitter minds hold on to lasting grudges.
components.title: Lore

components.textContent: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent’s army. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is your Vendetta target. Each time a **HERETIC ASTARTES** model from your army (excluding **DAMNED** models) makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, you can re‑roll the Hit roll.
Twisted Doctrine
These Renegades ally their knowledge of the Codex Astartes with their own unrestrained savagery to horrific effect.
components.title: Lore

components.textContent:
In your Movement phase, each time you set up or select a **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit (excluding Battle‑shocked units) from your army to move, it can choose to Default to Doctrine. If it does, it must first take a Battle‑shock test. Then, select one of the following:

■ Until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
■ Until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Many Renegades eschew the gifts of Dark Gods, relying only upon their own martial prowess to sweep forth and destroy the foe.
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Forge’s Blessing
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly **HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE** unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

enhancements.name: Invigorated Mechatendrils
enhancements.rules: **WARPSMITH** model only. Add 4" to the bearer’s Move characteristic.

enhancements.name: Soul Harvester
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time an enemy unit within 12" of the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Tempting Addendum
enhancements.rules:
**HERETIC ASTARTES** model only. Each time a **HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE** unit from your army invokes its contract while within 3" of the bearer:

• If it suffers one or more mortal wounds as a result of that Dark Pact, add 1 to the number of mortal wounds it suffers.
• Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Desperate Pledge
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Glut of Souls
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE** unit from your army (excluding **TITANIC** units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack that destroys an enemy model, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit regains 1 lost wound after all of its attacks have been resolved (to a maximum of 6 wounds).

stratagems.name: Daemonic Possession
stratagems.whenRules: Your Command phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE** unit from your army (excluding **DAEMON** units).
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the battle, your unit has the **DAEMON** keyword.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Rampage
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE** or **VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE** unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.

stratagems.name: Predatory Pursuit
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE** or **VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE** unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Feeding Frenzy
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**) is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE** or **VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE** unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit (excluding **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**) that is within Engagement Range of your unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

components.textContent:
Each time a **HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE** unit from your army makes a Dark Pact, it can invoke its contract. If it does, subtract 1 from the resulting Leadership test when making that Dark Pact, and until the end of the phase:

• Each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
• Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

Many are the daemons who have forged pacts with Vashtorr the Arkifane. Once bound into such a contract, a soul debt must be paid, one that the daemon strives endlessly, and with all its desperation, to fulfil.
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Eager for Vengeance
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model only (excluding **DAMNED** models). The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, if the bearer’s unit Fell Back this turn, add 1 to the Hit roll, and each time you select your focus of hatred as a target of that unit’s charge, add 1 to the Charge roll.

enhancements.name: Eye of Abaddon
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model only (excluding **DAMNED** models). While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time your focus of hatred is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Mark of Legend
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model only (excluding **DAMNED** models). Once per turn, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one saving throw made for the bearer.

enhancements.name: Warmaster’s Gift
enhancements.rules: **CHAOS LORD** model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, an unmodified successful Wound roll of 5+ scores a Critical Wound.

stratagems.name: Endless Ire
stratagems.whenRules: Any phase, just after your focus of hatred is destroyed.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER** unit from your army (excluding **Damned** units).
stratagems.effectRules: Select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is considered to be your focus of hatred.

stratagems.name: Contemptuous Disregard
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army (excluding **DAMNED** units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Bringers of Despair
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army (excluding **DAMNED** units) that is within Engagement Range of your focus of hatred.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: Black Crusade
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit or **HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED** unit from your army (excluding **DAMNED** units).
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, and bolt pistols, boltguns and combi-bolters equipped by models in your unit have the **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** ability while your unit has not already inflicted 6 wounds this turn using that ability.

stratagems.name: Let the Galaxy Burn
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army (excluding **TZEENTCH** units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the **[IGNORES COVER]** ability, and change the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit to 6.

stratagems.name: Millennia of Experience
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** or **HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED** unit from your army (excluding **DAMNED** units) that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

components.textContent: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent’s army to be your focus of hatred. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a **HERETIC ASTARTES** model from your army (excluding **DAMNED** models) makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

The eldest of the Chaos Space Marines harbour within their corrupted souls a burning desire for vengeance upon the Imperium and the galaxy as a whole. They channel this ire against their chosen targets, relentlessly pursuing their victims until every last foe lies dead upon the battlefield.
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Akshur’s Binding Runes
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer’s unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

enhancements.name: Eye of the Warp
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model with the Deep Strike ability only. Each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Infernal Fulgurite
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model only (excluding **DAMNED** models). Once per battle, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this phase.

enhancements.name: Tzagulla
enhancements.rules: **HERETIC ASTARTES** model with the Deep Strike ability only. Improve the Attacks, Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s weapons by 1. In addition, each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield from Reserves, until the end of the turn, improve the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s weapons by 1.

stratagems.name: Empyric Dislocation
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army (excluding **DAMNED** units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.restrictionRules: You cannot target the same unit with the Empyric Dislocation and Armour of Corruption Stratagems in the same phase.

stratagems.name: Armour of Corruption
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR**, **OBLITERATORS** or **MUTILATORS** unit from your army  that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.restrictionRules: You cannot target the same unit with the Armour of Corruption and Empyric Dislocation Stratagems in the same phase.

stratagems.name: Warp Flicker
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR**, **OBLITERATORS** or **MUTILATORS** unit from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Warp-Tainted
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR**, **OBLITERATORS** or **MUTILATORS** unit from your army, within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effectRules: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Siegebreaker Strike
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetRules: Up to two **HERETIC ASTARTES** units from your army that were set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and have not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your units have the **[IGNORES COVER]** ability.

stratagems.name: Portal of Spite
stratagems.whenRules: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit has +2 to **charge rolls.**

components.textContent:
At the end of your opponent’s turn, you can select a number of **HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR**, **OBLITERATORS** and **MUTILATORS** units from your army (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units). The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:

Battle Size - Number of Units
Incursion - Up to 1 unit
Strike Force - Up to 2 units
Onslaught Up - to 3 units

Once you have made your selections, remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

Conjured warp portals flicker across the battlefield, tearing through the fabric of reality according to arcane designs. They are a means, however perilous and unnatural, for the warband’s most elite warriors to traverse the battlefield in a matter of strides and strike again at new locations.
